description: "Mistakes of Moses" by Robert Green Ingersoll is a critical examination of the biblical texts, specifically focusing on the Pentateuch, written in the late 19th century. The book offers a rationalist perspective on religious doctrines, questioning the historical and moral validity of the teachings attributed to Moses and the divine inspiration of scripture.
